subject: Data Engineering
title: Materialized Views
description: A quick, practical guide to Materialized Views.

hook.text: The same expensive query runs every time the dashboard loads. Why not store the result?

buildup.text: A materialized view pre-computes and stores query results, serving future requests instantly.

discovery.text: Unlike regular views, materialized views have physical storage and need periodic refreshing.

twist.text: Stale materialized views serve outdated data. Auto-refresh schedules add cost and complexity.

climax.text: Use materialized views for stable, frequently queried aggregations — not for rapidly changing data.

punchline.text: Compute once, serve many. But refresh wisely.

quiz.question: What is the key benefit of a materialized view?
options: Pre-computed results that serve queries instantly
